## Summary

Based on my investigation, here's what I found:

### (1) **Root Cause Hypothesis**

The Pendo heading doesn't get margin underneath due to **missing selector coverage in the survey text.css margin rule**.

**Exact problem:**
- [card.css line 139](card.css#L139): `._pendo-step-container-styles > :is(div, form, textarea, h2):not(._pendo-row)` applies `margin-bottom: var(--instui-component-shared-tokens-spacing-general-space-sm)` to h2 direct children in surveys ✓
  
- [text.css lines 139–147](text.css#L139-L147): Inside the survey scope (`:is(:scope, [class*="instui"])._pendo-guide-walkthrough_...`), the margin shorthand is applied to:
  - `h2._pendo-simple-text`
  - `._pendo-text-title ._pendo-simple-text` (descendant)
  - `h3._pendo-simple-text`
  - `._pendo-text-subTitle ._pendo-simple-text`
  - `._pendo-simple-text._pendo-nps-open-text-poll-question`

**The gap:** When an h2 element has **only** the `_pendo-text-title` class (not `._pendo-simple-text`), it doesn't match any text.css survey selectors. It only gets margin from card.css, which is correct, BUT because text.css comes later in cascade and would have equal specificity if a selector matched, relying on only card.css for this case suggests fragile cascade ordering.

### (2) **Smallest Likely Fix**

Add `h2._pendo-text-title` and `h3._pendo-text-subTitle` to the survey margin selector list in [text.css line 139](text.css#L139):

```css
h2._pendo-simple-text,
h2._pendo-text-title,  // ← ADD THIS
._pendo-text-title ._pendo-simple-text,
h3._pendo-simple-text,
h3._pendo-text-subTitle,  // ← ADD THIS (for consistency)
._pendo-text-subTitle ._pendo-simple-text,
._pendo-simple-text._pendo-nps-open-text-poll-question {
  margin: var(--pendo-space-0) var(--pendo-space-0)
    var(--instui-component-shared-tokens-spacing-general-space-sm);
  // ... other properties
}
```

### (3) **Tests / Validation Commands**

- [renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts](renderers/pendo/tests/build.test.ts) — Run to confirm the CSS builds without errors after changes
- Scan [renderers/pendo/generated/global.css](renderers/pendo/generated/global.css) to verify the compiled selectors include `h2._pendo-text-title`
- Browser test: Render a survey guide with a bare h2 (class `_pendo-text-title` only) and verify visual bottom spacing

**Build/test command:**
```bash
vp test renderers/pendo
vp run generate  # regenerate global.css
```

### (4) **Ambiguity**

- **Actual DOM structure unclear**: Whether `_pendo-text-title` wraps an h2/h3 or IS the h2/h3 itself affects selector matching. The git log or Pendo source would clarify which pattern Pendo uses.
- **Inline style override possibility**: If Pendo injects inline `style` attributes on headings, any margin set via CSS will be overridden. Inspect the live DOM to rule this out.
- **Other layout contexts**: Alert and popover layouts don't have corresponding margin rules in text.css for h2/h3, suggesting they may rely entirely on card.css or different spacing patterns. Verify if headings in alerts/popovers have margin issues too.
